market_question: Will Marco Rubio win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
reasoning: Marco Rubio is a plausible but not dominant Republican candidate for 2028. The open field, combined with the usual low probability of any individual winning a future presidential election, suggests a true probability closer to 6%. The market price of 13.8% overestimates his chances, offering a negative edge on Yes. Thus, betting No presents value.
evidence_points: Historical probability of a specific non-incumbent, non-frontrunner winning the presidency is low.
Rubio failed to secure the nomination in 2016 and lacks a unique coalition.
2028 is far off; many unknown candidates could emerge.
